items.question: How do I set up monitoring to avoid alert fatigue?
items.answer: Tier your accounts by priority, set like thresholds and time windows per tier, and start narrow. Expand conditions only after validating alert quality.

items.question: Can it detect old videos that suddenly go viral?
items.answer: Yes. The system flags abnormal engagement growth against historical baselines, catching 'second-wave' viral content you'd miss in a daily feed check.

items.question: How do monitoring results flow into team workflows?
items.answer: Matched content syncs to Lark Base automatically. Ops, content, and strategy teams annotate, assign, and review on the same shared dataset.

items.question: Can I also monitor my own account?
items.answer: Yes. Add your own account to the same watchlist and compare your metrics against competitors using identical rules — one unified view.
